parameters.deformation: multi-pass and small deformation to about 1 mm

evidence.quote: After the oxide scale was removed, the alloy was cold rolled to about 1 mm by multi-pass and small deformation.
The cold rolled specimen needed to be annealed at 1050 ／C176 C for 10 min to improve the mechanical performance of the FeCrAl alloy.

attributes.composition: rich in Mo and Nb, HCP structure

evidence.quote: Figure 7(c) was a SAED pattern, which showed that the structure of precipitates was HCP, so the precipitated phase was the Laves phase.
The Laves phase was seen to be precipitated at the intragranular level, and the amount of Laves phases increased as the Nb and Mo contents increased.
